constructs.merged_construct: Stimulus-gated plasticity reserve (suntan-callus plasticity field)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T041 is a quietly-degrading global optimization property (effective rank decay, microsecond-to-epoch scale, an abstract process). L156 and L142 are slow bodily homeostatic responses at day-to-week scale that build AND decay with a lag, and that localize protection to where load recurs. Tech axis = scalar trainability of a net; life axis = spatially-resolved, hysteretic tissue adaptation. No literature co-occurrence between 'plasticity loss in nets' and 'tan/callus dynamics'.
constructs.mechanism: Replace the single global plasticity scalar with a per-unit (or per-channel) plasticity reserve variable p_i that obeys borrowed dual-lag tissue dynamics. Two coupled first-order processes: (a) DEPLETION proportional to recent local gradient throughput / activation load on unit i (callus rule: protection-as-stiffening accrues where load recurs, so a heavily-used unit's reserve is slowly converted into committed/rigid weight, lowering its future learning rate), and (b) RECOVERY toward a baseline when the unit is under-used, but with the asymmetric lag of a tan: build-up time constant tau_up != decay time constant tau_down, so reserve both ramps and fades behind the stimulus rather than tracking it instantly. The per-unit learning-rate multiplier at step t is an increasing function of p_i(t). Crucially, because the reserve lags, a unit that was idle during an early task regains learnability only after a delay, predicting a measurable re-plasticization latency.
constructs.what_it_produces: A continual-learning optimizer with per-unit hysteretic learning-rate gating, plus a concrete falsifiable prediction: networks should show a 're-plasticization latency' — after a period of disuse a saturated unit recovers fittability not instantly but on a fixed time constant, and the ratio tau_down/tau_up should set how reversible plasticity loss is. Measurable object: a per-unit 'reserve' field whose spatial pattern (which channels are 'callused') predicts WHERE catastrophic forgetting will strike next.
constructs.human_blind_spot_reason: Plasticity-loss researchers reach for spectral/effective-rank fixes and treat trainability as a scalar global health metric; they do not file skin tanning and callus thickening under 'optimizer state'. The asymmetric build/decay lag and load-localized stiffening are obvious in dermatology but invisible from inside the optimization-theory frame.
constructs.generation_trace: Picked tech anchor T041 (plasticity loss) from the training-dynamics pool. Asked: what life processes have the SAME shape as 'a capacity that degrades with use and is hard to recover'? Searched body-health pool -> callus (L142: protection accrues exactly where load recurs) and fading suntan (L156: a response that builds under stimulus then decays once it stops, lagging both ways). Operator = DYNAMICS_BORROW: imported the suntan's asymmetric up/down time-constants and the callus's load-localized accrual as the update rule for a NEW per-unit reserve state variable, replacing T041's scalar view. Derivation step: load->deplete (callus), idle->slow-recover-with-lag (tan) => predicts re-plasticization latency, an object neither parent yields alone.

constructs.merged_construct: Subtractive depth readout (autumn-leaf unmasking + tree-ring depth record)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T024 is a representation-learning phenomenon (class manifolds separate with depth, framed as ADDITIVE construction of features layer by layer). L127 is a seasonal botanical recycling process whose key move is SUBTRACTIVE: green pigment is withdrawn to reveal colors already present. L129 is a passive dendrochronological record in ordered concentric bands. Scales: forward-pass microseconds vs annual/seasonal; ontology: a learned transformation vs a withdrawal process vs an archival object. These are never co-discussed.
constructs.mechanism: Two transferred skeletons. (1) UNMASKING (from L127): hypothesize that layer-wise 'sharpening' is partly subtractive — late layers do not build the class signal so much as withdraw/suppress nuisance directions that were masking a class signal already linearly present early on. Test by training a per-layer suppression mask m_l and measuring whether class decodability after applying only suppression (zeroing predicted-nuisance directions) reproduces the depth accuracy curve. (2) RING RECORD (from L129): treat the stack of intermediate representations as concentric annual rings — read 'depth bands' to reconstruct, in order, what each layer removed. A wide 'ring' (large representational change at layer l) marks a layer that did heavy unmasking; a thin ring marks a near-identity layer. The ordered sequence of ring widths becomes a passive provenance record of how the network resolved the input.
constructs.what_it_produces: A diagnostic method: a 'subtractivity index' per layer (fraction of accuracy gain attributable to nuisance suppression vs new-feature construction) and a 'representational tree-ring' profile that orders layers by how much resolving work each did. Prediction: networks generalizing well will show most class information present EARLY and a late subtractive phase, whereas memorizing networks build the signal late (additive). Measurable object: ring-width spectrum that distinguishes unmasking-dominant from construction-dominant architectures.
constructs.human_blind_spot_reason: Interpretability defaults to an additive, build-up narrative ('features compose into higher features with depth'). The autumn insight — that the colors were there all along and depth merely strips the cover — is filed under botany, not under probing classifiers. And nobody reads a residual stack as dendrochronology.
constructs.generation_trace: Tech anchor T024 (layer-wise sharpening) chosen from representation-learning pool. Key question: is depth additive or could it be subtractive? Scanned nature pool for a subtractive-reveal process -> L127 leaves (explicitly: withdraw green to unmask colors already there). Then needed a way to READ the per-layer history -> L129 tree rings (ordered passive record of conditions). Operator = STRUCTURAL_TRANSFER: carried the unmasking skeleton onto the layer stack (gives subtractivity index) and the concentric-ring skeleton onto the residual-stream deltas (gives ring-width provenance). constructs.merged_construct: Tidal-migratory curriculum (cue-timed oscillating difficulty schedule)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T013 is a monotone easy-to-hard training schedule (an engineered control signal over an epoch). L122 is a deterministic astronomical oscillation (sea level cycling on a fixed period). L123 is a populational, cue-triggered seasonal movement between resource peaks. constructs.mechanism: Replace the monotone difficulty ramp with two borrowed dynamics. (1) TIDAL exposure (L122): difficulty d(t) oscillates on a fixed period rather than rising monotonically — easy and hard examples are alternately 'submerged' and 'exposed' to the optimizer, so each region of data difficulty is repeatedly revisited (an anti-forgetting tide) instead of left behind. (2) MIGRATORY cueing (L123): the phase/period of the tide is not fixed by a hand-set schedule but TRIGGERED by an internal environmental cue — analogous to birds departing on a resource cue, the schedule advances to the next difficulty band only when a readiness signal fires (e.g., loss-curvature flattening or gradient-noise-scale crossing a threshold), so pacing self-times to the model's state. Combine: an oscillating-difficulty curriculum whose oscillation phase is gated by an internal readiness cue.
constructs.what_it_produces: A self-pacing curriculum algorithm: oscillating (not monotone) difficulty with cue-triggered band transitions, plus a prediction that this beats monotone curricula specifically on continual / multi-distribution training by preventing the 'left-behind easy data' forgetting that monotone ramps cause. Measurable object: an optimal tidal period (data-revisit frequency) that minimizes forgetting, expected to scale with the gradient-noise-scale-derived readiness time.
constructs.human_blind_spot_reason: Curriculum learning is culturally locked to MONOTONE easy-to-hard (the pedagogy metaphor). Tides (periodic re-exposure) and migration (departure timed to an internal cue rather than a calendar) come from astronomy/ecology and are not part of the ML curriculum vocabulary, so the oscillating, self-cued schedule sits in a blind corner.

Operator = DYNAMICS_BORROW: imported tide's periodic exposure as d(t) oscillation and migration's cue-triggered departure as the band-transition trigger. Step-by-step: monotone -> oscillate (tide) -> but when to switch phase? -> cue it to model readiness (migration). Produces self-pacing oscillating curriculum + optimal-period prediction, which neither monotone curriculum nor tides alone give.

constructs.merged_construct: Bloom-crash batch ecology (resource-overshoot minibatch dynamics)

parents.name: Stranded ecosystem in a drying pool

constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T010 is an optimization statistic (variance/magnitude ratio fixing critical batch size). L141 is a population-ecology overshoot-and-collapse driven by self-exhaustion of a nutrient. L140 is a shrinking-habitat crowding dynamic where an isolated community endures rising scarcity. Tech = a static threshold quantity; life = nonlinear population trajectories with resource feedback. Scales: per-step gradients vs bloom seasons. Ecology-of-batches is not a discussed pairing.
constructs.mechanism: Reframe the data a batch 'consumes' as a nutrient pool with feedback. (1) BLOOM-CRASH (L141): treat each cluster/concept in the data as a finite nutrient; the optimizer 'blooms' (rapid loss decrease) on a concept while its effective per-example gradient signal is rich, but as the model fits that concept its remaining informative gradient is EXHAUSTED, so the bloom overshoots and the per-concept gradient-noise-scale spikes (signal gone, only noise left) — a crash signature. (2) DRYING-POOL crowding (L140): as a concept's informative examples shrink, the surviving 'hard residual' examples are crowded into a small high-variance pool that dominates the batch, raising the gradient noise scale locally. Mechanism = monitor a per-concept gradient-noise-scale and detect the bloom->crash transition (signal-to-noise collapse) to decide when a concept is 'mined out' and reweight the data mixture away from it, redistributing capacity like water returning to a drying pool.
constructs.what_it_produces: A data-mixture controller that uses per-concept gradient-noise-scale TRAJECTORIES (not the global scalar) to detect concept saturation, plus the prediction that informative-gradient exhaustion produces a characteristic overshoot-then-noise-spike curve per concept. Measurable object: a per-concept 'bloom-crash' SNR trajectory whose crash point predicts diminishing returns earlier than aggregate loss does — a stopping/reweighting signal for curriculum and data-pruning.
constructs.human_blind_spot_reason: Gradient noise scale is treated as one global number for setting batch size; nobody resolves it per-concept and reads it as a population trajectory. The bloom-overshoot-crash and drying-pool-crowding shapes are ecology, mentally filed far from optimizer telemetry, so the per-concept exhaustion signature is missed.
constructs.generation_trace: Tech anchor T010 (gradient noise scale) from optimization pool. Reframed 'data informativeness' as a depletable resource and searched ecology pool for resource-feedback dynamics: L141 algal bloom (overshoot then crash from self-exhaustion) and L140 drying pool (crowding as resource shrinks). Operator = DYNAMICS_BORROW: imported the bloom-crash trajectory and crowding feedback onto a PER-CONCEPT gradient-noise-scale, turning a static scalar into a population time-series. Derivation: fit a concept -> exhaust its informative gradient -> SNR crashes (bloom) -> hard residuals crowd the batch (drying pool) -> detect crash to reweight. Yields a saturation-detection controller no parent gives alone.

constructs.merged_construct: Pre-strain flat-minimum priming (stretch-and-break-in robustness)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T029 is an optimization method (ascend to a worst-case nearby point, then descend, to find flat minima). L187 is a physiological preparation that raises the strain-to-injury threshold by priming tissue. L178 is a mutual-deformation process where two bodies co-adapt until fit improves. Tech = adversarial geometry of a loss surface; life = tissue mechanics and wear-in. Scales: per-step optimization vs minutes (warm-up) to weeks (break-in). These are not co-discussed.
constructs.mechanism: Two borrowed dynamics refine SAM's perturb-then-descend. (1) STRETCH PRIMING (L187): before the main task gradient, apply a scheduled 'warm-up perturbation' whose magnitude RAMPS over training (like progressive stretching), explicitly raising the curvature-tolerance threshold ahead of hard updates — i.e., grow the SAM neighborhood radius rho on a priming schedule rather than fixing it, so the model is pre-conditioned to tolerate larger strain before each difficult phase. (2) MUTUAL BREAK-IN (L178): make the perturbation direction co-adapt with the data, not just adversarial to the weights — alternate small deformations of weights AND of the input augmentation distribution so model and data 'wear into' each other, trading early-training discomfort (higher loss) for a later better-fitting, flatter joint configuration. Result: a curriculum over the sharpness-penalty radius plus a co-deformation of model and augmentation.
constructs.what_it_produces: A scheduled-radius SAM variant ('priming SAM') with a ramped neighborhood and model-data co-deformation, plus a prediction: ramping rho on a stretch schedule yields flatter minima with less early-training instability than fixed-rho SAM, and the optimal ramp should track the layer's emerging curvature. Measurable object: a strain-threshold curve (max tolerable rho without loss blow-up) that rises over training exactly as a warm-up curve predicts.
constructs.human_blind_spot_reason: SAM is framed as a fixed adversarial radius; the idea that the tolerance to perturbation should be progressively raised by priming (warm-up) and that model and data should co-deform (break-in) lives in sports physiology and footwear, not optimization. The dynamic, ramped, mutual view is in a blind corner because rho is treated as a hyperparameter, not a tissue that warms up.

Body pool -> L187 stretching (raises injury threshold via priming) and L178 breaking-in shoes (mutual deformation toward fit). Operator = DYNAMICS_BORROW: imported the ramping-threshold dynamic (stretch) to schedule SAM's rho, and the mutual-deformation dynamic (break-in) to co-adapt weights and augmentations. Step: fixed rho -> ramped rho (stretch) -> one-sided perturbation -> two-sided co-deformation (break-in). Produces priming-SAM + strain-threshold prediction beyond either parent.

constructs.merged_construct: Datable forgetting scars (bruise-clock provenance of overwritten knowledge)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T014 is a continual-learning failure (new-task gradients overwrite old-task weights). L143 is wound healing with hastily-laid disordered fibers that close but never restore full function. L152 is a forensic process where staged blood breakdown makes color encode injury AGE. Tech = parameter overwriting; life = tissue repair quality + a temporal clock. Scales: training steps vs days of healing. The pairing 'forgetting as a datable scar' is absent from the literature.
constructs.mechanism: Two transferred skeletons. (1) SCAR (L143): when a new task overwrites weights important to an old task, the repaired region is not restored to its original ORDERED structure but to a 'scar' — a lower-rank, disordered weight patch that restores partial function (closure) but with permanently reduced effective capacity. Predict and measure: regions of weight space that have been overwritten show higher disorder / lower effective rank and a function ceiling below their pre-injury level even after relearning. (2) BRUISE CLOCK (L152): borrow the staged-color-encodes-age structure to build a DATING method — attach to each parameter (or block) a small set of slowly-relaxing auxiliary statistics (e.g., a cascade of EMA traces with different time constants) whose joint 'color' encodes how long ago that parameter was last catastrophically overwritten. Reading the cascade dates the forgetting event, just as bruise color dates an injury.
constructs.what_it_produces: A forgetting-forensics method: (a) a 'scar map' of which weights were overwritten and are now functionally capped (low-rank disordered patches), and (b) a multi-timescale 'bruise clock' that estimates WHEN each region was overwritten. Prediction: relearning a scarred task plateaus below first-learning accuracy (a measurable scar ceiling), and the bruise-clock readout correlates with the recency of the interfering task. Measurable object: a per-block age estimate of last interference, usable to schedule rehearsal toward the freshest scars.
constructs.human_blind_spot_reason: Continual-learning work asks how to PREVENT forgetting, not how to DATE it or characterize the repaired region's quality. Wound-healing's 'closes but never fully restores' and forensic bruise-aging are filed under medicine, so treating overwritten weights as datable scar tissue is a corner human researchers skip.
constructs.generation_trace: Tech anchor T014 (catastrophic forgetting) from continual-learning pool. Asked two questions: what is the QUALITY of repaired weights, and can we DATE the damage? Body pool gave L143 scar tissue (repair restores closure not function -> capacity ceiling) and L152 bruise cycle (staged decay encodes age -> a clock). Operator = STRUCTURAL_TRANSFER: carried the scar's disordered-low-function structure onto overwritten weight blocks, and the bruise's age-encoding cascade onto multi-timescale parameter statistics. Derivation: overwrite -> disordered low-rank scar (ceiling) + attach relaxing traces -> read 'color' to date the event. Yields a forensics method (scar map + bruise clock) absent from either parent.

constructs.merged_construct: Ripening-signal contrastive co-maturation
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T016 is a representation-learning objective (pull positives together, push negatives apart, treating items as independent). L126 is an ecological mutualism (each partner supplies what the other cannot make). L131 is a proximity-propagated maturation (one ripe fruit emits a gas that ripens neighbors). Tech = a pairwise loss over fixed views; life = inter-organism exchange and contagion-of-state. Scales: embedding steps vs days of ripening. 'Contrastive learning with a ripening contagion' is not a discussed pairing.
constructs.mechanism: Two borrowed dynamics modify the static positive/negative scheme. (1) SYMBIOTIC PAIRS (L126): instead of treating a positive pair symmetrically, let each member of a positive pair SUPPLY a representational component the other lacks — e.g., split the embedding into a self-encoded part and a partner-supplied part, training each view to provide the complement its positive cannot infer alone (mutual completion loss), so positives co-define rather than merely co-locate. (2) RIPENING CONTAGION (L131): borrow the gas-propagated maturation as a dynamic over the embedding's confidence/temperature: when an anchor becomes well-separated ('ripe'), it emits a signal that lowers the loss temperature for its nearest neighbors in latent space, accelerating THEIR maturation — a spatial, propagating curriculum where confident regions ripen their neighbors. Combine: symbiotic complementary positives plus neighbor-propagated maturation scheduling.
constructs.what_it_produces: A contrastive method with (a) complementary (symbiotic) positives and (b) a neighbor-propagated maturation schedule, plus a prediction: representation quality should spread spatially through latent space as a 'ripening front' from well-separated clusters outward, measurable as a maturation wavefront in cluster-separation over training. Measurable object: a latent-space ripening-front speed that predicts which clusters separate next.
constructs.human_blind_spot_reason: Contrastive learning treats each pair independently and uses a global temperature; the ideas that positives should mutually SUPPLY missing structure (mutualism) and that confidence should propagate locally like a ripening gas (contagion) come from ecology and post-harvest biology, mentally distant from loss-function design, so this corner is skipped.

Nature pool -> L126 symbiosis (each supplies what the other can't -> complementary positives) and L131 ripening cluster (proximity-propagated state change -> neighbor-driven curriculum). Operator = DYNAMICS_BORROW: imported symbiosis's mutual-supply relation into the positive-pair loss and the ripening gas's propagation into a neighbor-conditioned temperature schedule. Step: symmetric positives -> complementary positives (symbiosis); global temperature -> neighbor-propagated temperature (ripening). Predicts a measurable latent ripening-front, which neither parent yields.

constructs.merged_construct: Natal-basin homing with directional growth record (salmon-moss mode connectivity)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T002 is a loss-geometry fact (independently trained nets sit in basins split by a high ridge unless permuted into alignment). Scales: training epochs vs a salmon lifetime. No co-occurrence.

(1) NATAL HOMING (L135): reframe barrier-crossing between two solution basins as an energetically-costly upstream return to a 'natal' basin — define a homing procedure that spends a controlled budget (like lifetime reserves) to push a model UP the loss ridge along the steepest connectable direction toward a target basin, accepting transient high loss as the cost of return, then arriving for a single 'spawning' event (a merge/average that only succeeds at the natal basin). The budget needed to reach the natal basin measures the true barrier height under motion, not the static ridge. (2) MOSS COMPASS (L134): along the crossing path, lay down a passive directional record — accumulate, per parameter, a sign/orientation statistic of the gradient direction climbed (the 'shaded-face' analog), so the arrived model carries an encoding of WHICH way it climbed. This record reveals the permutation/symmetry orientation that aligned the basins, recoverable post hoc like reading moss to find north.
constructs.what_it_produces: A method to actively CROSS mode-connectivity barriers with a measured energy budget (homing) plus a passively-recorded 'climb compass' that recovers the symmetry/permutation alignment between two solutions from the crossing path itself. Prediction: the minimal homing budget to merge two nets correlates with their permutation misalignment, and the moss-compass record predicts the aligning permutation without separately solving the matching problem. Measurable object: a per-parameter directional record that decodes basin-alignment.
constructs.human_blind_spot_reason: Mode connectivity is studied as a STATIC geometric property (does a low-loss path exist after permutation?), not as an energetically-budgeted homing migration, and certainly nobody records the climb direction as a biological compass to recover symmetry. Salmon energetics and moss orientation are ecology, far from loss-landscape geometry.

Two questions: how to actively cross the ridge with a cost, and how to recover the alignment cheaply. Nature pool -> L135 salmon run (budgeted upstream return to a natal site -> energy-measured barrier crossing) and L134 moss-on-north (passive directional encoding -> record the climb direction). Operator = STRUCTURAL_TRANSFER: carried salmon homing energetics onto a budgeted ridge-ascent toward a target basin, and the moss compass onto a per-parameter gradient-orientation record. constructs.merged_construct: Re-entrainment test-time adaptation with recovery-noise signature (jet-lag / pins-and-needles inner loop)

Measurable object: a recovery-noise spike whose timing tells you when test-time training has converged for THIS instance.

constructs.merged_construct: Minimal-silk exploration patching (web-repair novelty budget)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T031 is an RL exploration mechanism (extra reward for poorly-predicted states drives policy toward novel regions). L133 is an animal-engineering behavior: patch a damaged trap LOCALLY at the lowest material cost instead of rebuilding. Tech = a global curiosity reward over state space; life = a least-cost local-repair policy on a physical structure. Different ontology (reward signal vs maintenance strategy) and scale (RL steps vs web repair). Not co-discussed.

Standard novelty bonuses spend exploration uniformly toward novelty everywhere (rebuild bias). Exploration becomes a sequence of minimal local repairs prioritized by tear size and patch cost, conserving the sample 'silk'.
constructs.what_it_produces: A sample-efficient exploration policy that ranks novelty targets by a repair-cost/coverage-gain ratio and patches the world-model's largest cheap-to-fix gaps first, plus a prediction: this beats uniform novelty bonuses in sample efficiency when exploration is costly, and the optimal patch order follows a tear-size / silk-cost ranking. Measurable object: a per-region 'repair ROI' map of the world model guiding where to explore next.
constructs.human_blind_spot_reason: Curiosity/novelty exploration is framed as a reward shaping signal pushing toward ALL poorly-predicted states; the spider's economics — patch the biggest tear locally for the least silk, defer the rest — is filed under animal behavior, not under exploration policies, so cost-ranked local model-repair is a blind corner.

constructs.merged_construct: Consonance-Allocated Superposition (frequency-ratio packing of attention features)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Three different ontologies and scales: T001 is a microsecond linear-algebra packing constraint (concepts > dimensions); L072 is a social-status allocation rule operating at the scale of a dinner table; L159 is an acoustic/perceptual law about integer frequency ratios. Status-ranking, psychoacoustics, and overcomplete coding never co-occur in a literature.
constructs.mechanism: Step 1: read off the defining constraint of L072 = WHO may sit adjacent is decided by a single ranked scalar (status). In superposition, the analogue is WHICH features may share overlapping directions in one head. Step 2 (INVERSION): replace the status scalar with the opposite kind of compatibility law taken from L159 -- two features may co-occupy a direction only if their co-activation time series stand in a SIMPLE frequency ratio (their cross-spectral peak ratio is near 2:1, 3:2, 4:3), i.e. they are 'consonant'; dissonant feature pairs (irrational-ratio co-activation) are forbidden from sharing a direction and are pushed orthogonal. Step 3: implement as a regularizer on a trained model -- compute, per pair of SAE-recovered features, the dominant ratio of their activation autocorrelation periods; add a penalty that grows with deviation from a small set of simple ratios for any pair whose directions have high cosine overlap. Step 4: features whose firing rhythms beat against each other are separated; features whose rhythms lock are allowed to interfere cheaply.
constructs.what_it_produces: A concrete interference-allocation method and a falsifiable prediction: superposition interference (measured as cross-feature read-out error) should be LOWER between feature pairs whose activation rhythms sit at simple integer ratios than between equally-overlapping pairs at irrational ratios -- a 'consonance' structure inside a single head that can be detected, then deliberately imposed to raise effective capacity without adding dimensions.

constructs.merged_construct: Feature Reputation Field (gossip-derived identity for dictionary features)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T034 is a static linear-algebra object (a learned overcomplete basis); L057 is a peer-to-peer message-mutation process among people; L060 is a distributed social-memory institution. Step 3: build the 'reputation' (L060) = aggregate all such second-hand descriptions of i into a vector (i's reputation = the population's distributed memory of how i behaves), and crucially let it MUTATE per layer-depth, exactly as gossip distorts on each hop. constructs.merged_construct: Plate-Spinning KV Cache: revisit-before-decay eviction as a juggling tournament
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T004 is a microsecond-scale online memory-budget rule in an inference server (process over abstract tokens). L173 is a circus-skill act on a human timescale where physical objects decay toward toppling. L101 is a children's collision game scored by displacement. constructs.mechanism: Run KV eviction NOT as a fixed scalar score (recency/attention-mass) but on the spinning-plates substrate: each cached key-value entry is a 'plate' with a decay clock; its 'wobble' = expected future attention demand estimated from a cheap recurrence (the running average of how recently/strongly later queries attended to it). The serving loop is a juggler with a bounded 'reach budget' = number of entries it can refresh per step. An entry survives only if it is revisited (its wobble re-estimated and it earns a keep) before its decay clock crosses the drop threshold. Borrow marbles-knockout for the eviction event itself: when the budget is full and a NEW high-wobble entry arrives, it does not evict the globally-min entry; it 'knocks out' whichever currently-cached entry it would physically collide with in a locality bucket (nearest in a learned key-hash zone), so eviction is a local collision, not a global argmin. This makes eviction O(1) per insert and biases retention toward a spatially spread set of plates rather than a temporally clustered one.

Prediction: collision-local eviction (marbles rule) yields higher recall of rare distant tokens than global-min (H2O/heavy-hitter style) eviction at the SAME memory budget, because it prevents the 'temporal clustering' failure where a burst of recent tokens evicts an entire earlier topic at once. Yields a measurable 'plate-drop rate' (fraction of evicted entries that a later query actually needed) as an online cache-quality metric servers can log.

constructs.merged_construct: Pantry-Rotation Serving: household FIFO-by-arrival lifted to datacenter staleness-aware prefetch
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: L180 is a single-household kitchen habit operating on a weekly timescale over a dozen cans. The serving loop runs pantry rotation: on every router decision, shards whose expiry is near are pulled to the 'front' (kept resident and pre-warmed) so they are consumed-or-evicted before they silently go stale, instead of sitting at the 'back' (cold tier) past a version bump where they would be served WRONG. Use T056's consistent-hashing ring to decide WHICH node holds which shelf so that when a model version rotates, only a contiguous arc of shards needs re-shelving (minimal remap), exactly mirroring 'first-in-first-out by arrival' across a fleet.

constructs.merged_construct: Fishing-Rod Speculative Decoding: patience-budgeted draft casting with a self-knotting backoff
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: T005 is a parallel-verification latency trick in LLM inference (sub-second, abstract tokens). L092 is a patience-vs-effort waiting hobby on a human timescale in a physical medium. L006 is a passive-disorder phenomenon of domestic cords. Three domains (inference / leisure / household entropy), three ontologies (process / activity / spontaneous-disorder), no co-occurrence.
constructs.mechanism: Swap speculative decoding onto the fishing substrate. Standard spec-decoding casts a FIXED-length draft block and verifies. Fishing reframes the draft as 'a baited lure left in a medium for a rare event, rewarding patience over continuous effort' (L092): the draft model casts a draft of ADAPTIVE length governed by a 'patience budget' — keep extending the speculative line as long as the running per-token acceptance probability (the 'nibble rate', estimated online from the verifier's recent accept/reject stream) stays above a threshold; reel in (stop and verify) the instant the nibble rate drops, because deeper casts past that point waste compute on tokens the big model will reject. Then borrow L006: long unconstrained drafts 'self-knot' — they accumulate compounding divergence from the target distribution through random agitation (each speculative step conditions on the previous speculative token, so error tangles). Add a 'detangling backoff': when consecutive rejections exceed a knot threshold, the draft length is geometrically shortened (cut the tangle) and the draft model's temperature is lowered, straightening the line before re-casting.
constructs.what_it_produces: A method (acceptance-rate-gated adaptive draft length with knot-backoff) and a prediction: the optimal speculative draft length is not a constant but tracks the LOCAL entropy of the target distribution — long casts in low-entropy (predictable) regions, short casts in high-entropy regions.
